title: Meet Romania
description: Travel to Romania with Spark and Mango: a country in Eastern Europe whose capital is Bucharest, where people speak Romanian and pay with the Romanian leu — plus two places we'd love to visit.

body.heading: Where in the world is Romania?
paragraphs: Romania is a country in Eastern Europe, which is part of Europe.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Romania is Bucharest.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Romania is Romanian.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Romania is the Romanian leu.

body.heading: How big is Romania?
paragraphs: Romania covers about 238,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about three times the size of Czechia.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Bran Castle, perched on a rock in the Carpathians, is forever linked with the Dracula legend — Transylvania's towns like Brașov and Sighișoara are medieval gems.
Where the Danube meets the Black Sea, its delta is a watery wilderness of pelicans, wild horses and fishing villages reached only by boat.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Romania on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?

takeaway: Romania in one breath: a country in Eastern Europe, capital Bucharest, where people speak Romanian and pay with the Romanian leu.
materials: A globe, atlas or world map (to find Romania)
Paper and crayons or pencils for the screen-free mission
supervision: Read this one together: a grown-up can help with tricky place names and hunt for Romania on the map as you read.
safetyNotes: Reading only — no physical activity is involved.
If your family ever visits the watery places in this article, water fun in Romania always needs a grown-up watching closely.
